sample:
Motorized portable machine (New, not refurbished)
DR Wireless panel (minimum 14” x 17”) with water and dust
protection and automatic exposure detection (AED)
Wireless panel that has a handle for easier carrying is
preferred, but not required
Physical Grid for use with the DR panel
On board (in bin or on machine) storage and charging of
DR panel
Collimator housing controls for collimation at minimum
Digital Source to Image Distance (SID) indicator is
preferred, but not required
Touchscreen display and control panel - 16” or larger
Pre-programmed techniques and views
Virtual Grid Software (scatter removal software post-
processing)
Image post-processing features that include, but not limited
to flip, windowing, rotation, reformatting, edge
enhancement, stitching, and annotations.
LED Light with crosshairs
Rotating tube and arm
